basis: coordination/handoffs/M-016-contract.md v1; exact C ABI/wire semantics wait for M freeze

cases.assert: destination delivers once and origin completes once after the specified end-to-end acknowledgement
no fabricated destination delivery; retries/queue/expiry stay bounded
with discovery/repair enabled and enough lifetime, use an actually received alternate route; never inject topology oracle into core

cases.stimulus: replay data and ACK, lose an ACK
cases.assert: application delivery/completion at most once per origin+boot+sequence; physical retransmissions still logged

cases.stimulus: cancel a queued/in-flight transaction then deliver a late ACK
cases.assert: no further retries after applicable cancellation; late ACK does not create a second terminal completion; specify in-flight boundary after ABI freeze
expired work is not resent/delivered as timely success; report explicit terminal status

cases.stimulus: reuse seq with a new origin boot; reboot an intermediate
cases.assert: new origin boot is a new identity; stale routes/dedup epochs handled by explicit frozen policy
reject/drop explicitly without exceeding capacity or erasing generated demand; no heap growth hidden in retries

cases.stimulus: same payload raw and reliable modes
cases.assert: raw does not add application retries; reliability/callback/delivery counters stay separate

cases.stimulus: info, unknown command, overlength input, unarmed bench
cases.assert: nonce/error visible; info/idle do not emit business; input size and finite bench bounds enforced
range/PDR/goodput/RTT measurement registry remains null with not_measured/hardware_not_available/source=null

cases.stimulus: 100 low-load sequential reliable transactions, concurrency=1, planned generation spacing 100ms and lifetime 60000ms; retain old raw DATA frames and replay them after seq17 and seq100 while their original dedup lifetime is live
cases.assert: all 100 complete once, including seq17 onward; live historical duplicates never redeliver. Replaying old packets after new admissions prevents eviction-to-pass from hiding loss of dedup. This is deterministic host functionality, not RF performance. Exact drain/tick schedule must use frozen core contract.
